## What and why

## Definition of Done (report Section 7.4)

- [ ] Tests added or updated and passing
- [ ] `make lint` and `make contracts` pass
- [ ] Docs, ADR or diagram updated if the design changed
- [ ] Reviewed by a teammate
- [ ] If a status, estimate, permission or evidence rule changed: the matching test names it
